about: Pepper's memory notes in Settings, then a turn starts and the memory re-read that comes with it fails. Staged: the three notes are written through the memory file route, and fetch is wrapped in the page so every memory file read answers 500 after the first shot; the turn is a message sent through the messages route.

script.text: The 9:04 from Central, same as usual.

steps.eval:
(async () => { const bots = (await (await fetch('/api/bots')).json()).bots; const pepper = bots.find((b) => b.name === 'Pepper'); const r = await fetch(`/api/bots/${pepper.id}/memory/file`, { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ path: 'MEMORY.md', text: '# Memory
- Prefers the 9am train on weekdays
- Keeps receipts in the Travel folder
- Likes short replies before noon
' }) }); return r.status; })()

(async () => { const real = window.fetch.bind(window); window.fetch = (input, init) => (String(input instanceof Request ? input.url : input).includes('/memory/file') && (!init || !init.method || init.method === 'GET')) ? Promise.resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Memory file unavailable' }), { status: 500, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } })) : real(input, init); const bots = (await (await real('/api/bots')).json()).bots; const pepper = bots.find((b) => b.name === 'Pepper'); const r = await real(`/api/bots/${pepper.id}/messages`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ text: 'Which train do I take tomorrow?', threadId: pepper.threadId, sendId: crypto.randomUUID() }) }); return r.status; })()
